statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 14% (low), Stress 51% (elevated), Confidence 87% (high), dominant mode trend-down. NQZ26 extended to a new session low of 30,957.50 at 09:40Z, confirming the failed 08:00Z reclaim of the 31,061.75 prior close, but that low was bought and the 10:00Z hour has compressed to the narrowest range of the overnight.
recommendation: Tail at 14% remains well below the 25% block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON and green for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The narrow evidence-based danger window spans 13:00Z to 15:00Z, covering the 13:30Z US cash open, the 13:45Z S&P Global September PMI finals and the 14:00Z September ISM Services release, where the published forecast reaches WATCH. Stress at 51% stays elevated and describes a difficult but recoverable environment driven by a 24-year-high yield backdrop; it does not alter the Tail-derived mapping.
headline: Tail rises to 14% as NQZ26 extended 17.25 points past the prior low to a new session low of 30,957.50 at 09:40Z, confirming the failed 08:00Z reclaim, though that low was bought and the 10:00Z hour has compressed to a 25-point band with last 30,988.25
body:
The prior hour scored a failed retracement and lifted Tail to 11%. This hour price supplied the follow-through question and answered it only halfway. NQZ26 broke the 30,974.75 low at roughly 09:35Z and printed a new session low of 30,957.50 in the 09:40Z bar, 17.25 points lower. That is repeated extension after a failed retracement, which the risk contract treats as a genuine Tail amplifier, and it is why Tail moves up from 11% rather than back down.

What the extension did not do is persist. The 30,957.50 low was bought within five minutes, price recovered to 30,997.75 by 09:50Z, and the 10:00Z hour has traded a roughly 25-point band between 30,976.75 and 31,002.00 with the last print 30,988.25 at 10:21:23Z. That is the narrowest hour of the entire overnight session, against 124.5 points in the 08:00Z hour and 84.5 points in the 09:00Z hour. Realised volatility is decaying while price sits a quarter of a percent below the prior close, which is the signature of an orderly drift rather than a pathological path.

The wider structure is a persistent but shallow downtrend. From the 31,221.25 high in the 01:00Z hour the index has given back 263.75 points, about 0.85%, through a sequence of lower highs and lower lows, interrupted by one genuine retracement into 31,099.25 at 08:15Z that then failed. Directional efficiency over nine hours is a real amplifier. Against it: every low in that sequence has been bought, the extension past the last low was 17.25 points rather than a second leg, and the move from the prior close is only 73.50 points.

Cross-asset evidence is aligned in direction but not in magnitude. ES is 0.18% lower at 7,763.00 against a 7,777.25 prior close, so Nasdaq is underperforming the broad index modestly. VIX is 16.29, up 6.40% from 15.31, a clear uptick from a low absolute base. The dollar index is 0.27% firmer at 102.209. WTI is 90.79 dollars, 0.35% lower, inside a wide 89.31 to 91.88 range, while Brent above 102 dollars carries a Strait of Hormuz risk premium. Gold is effectively flat at 4,185.70, which argues against a genuine flight to quality. The dominant macro driver remains the bond market: the 10-year closed Friday near 5.28% after touching 5.34%, its highest since 2002, and cash Treasuries are closed overnight so no live confirmation is available.

Tail at 14% reflects one confirmed amplifier, directional efficiency plus extension past a failed retracement, set against functioning mean reversion, collapsing realised range and a modest absolute move. Stress rises a point to 51% for the yield regime, the VIX uptick and new session lows arriving ahead of a high-impact release. Confidence eases a point to 87% because the live five-minute NQ path through 10:21:23Z is excellent but there is no live cash Treasury print and the shared Finviz context is roughly six days stale and partial, so breadth, megacap and semiconductor confirmation is genuinely unavailable this run.

lookbackSummary: Twenty-three of the 24 preceding published hours are available from Claude history. The 06:00Z slot on 5 October is explicitly unavailable because no assessment was published inside that clock-hour; its fields are null rather than interpolated. Tail was pinned at 3% from 10:00Z through 21:00Z on 4 October because the CME equity-index complex was halted for the weekend and no Nasdaq-100 price path was scoreable, while Stress stayed in the 64-73% band on the standing yield regime. Tail then rose through the Sunday reopen as the overnight drift extended, reaching 12% at 22:00Z and peaking at 15% at 01:00Z on 5 October. It decayed to 8% by 04:00Z as the drift stayed orderly, reached a low of 6% at 08:00Z when the 31,061.75 prior close was briefly reclaimed, then rose to 11% at 09:00Z once that reclaim failed. Every available hour mapped to EA_ON and green. Past opinions are preserved exactly as published and are not restated with hindsight.
outlookSummary: The follow-through question from the prior hour is now partly answered. NQZ26 extended 17.25 points past the 30,974.75 low to a new session low of 30,957.50 at 09:40Z, confirming that the 08:00Z reclaim of the 31,061.75 prior close had failed, but the low was immediately bought and the 10:00Z hour has compressed into a roughly 25-point band between 30,976.75 and 31,002.00, the narrowest of the overnight. Tail therefore rises only to 14%. The published path holds 14% through the European session, lifts to 18% as the 13:00Z-15:00Z danger window opens around the 13:30Z cash open and the 13:45Z S&P Global PMI finals, and peaks at 21% for the 14:00Z September ISM Services release, where the mapping reaches WATCH. That peak is a conditional repricing window, not an assertion that one-way structure will appear: event importance raises Stress and lowers Confidence before it raises Tail, and Tail falls back to 17% by 16:00Z on the assumption that post-release discovery is orderly. Thereafter the path decays to 10-12% through the futures-only and Asian sessions, with Confidence falling from 87% to a 53% horizon floor at the 23-hour limit. The invalidation for the whole path is sustained trade below 30,957.50 on shallow or failed pullbacks; the upside neutraliser is a durable reclaim of 31,061.75.
